answer: To reach the zenith of sybil resistance, make each agent identity lock a refundable bond in a settlement bridge contract. A public VRF beacon periodically drafts random agents to solve a fresh micro-challenge proving unique hardware execution within minutes, published to an open nebula of attestations. Missed or copied challenges slash the bond. An attacker spawning N sybils must lock N bonds and run N proving pipelines in real time; fakes cannot parallelize cheaply. Limit: rich actors still pass, so add peer-stake slashing and withdrawal cooldowns to price identity churn.
